history.sg_progress: The Administration did not accept this recommendation requiring it to consider awarding contracts based on the rate alone, as there would be no consideration given to credit exposure. The Treasury has a clear process in place whereby the most competitive rate is chosen for each month, while also taking into consideration the requirement to limit credit exposure. Getting quotes from three counterparties with which the United Nations has International Swaps and Derivatives Association agreements is considered a sufficient number to get market rates. The United Nations foreign currency hedging and budget rates guidelines state that the hedging programme should be allocated between the financial institutions with which the Organization has executed an International Swaps and Derivatives Association document in order to reduce credit risk.
